thread:
Omar (customer): hey @support we started seeing a surge of 400 errors from /v1/embeddings around 09:12 UTC. error message says "EmbeddingDimensionMismatch: expected 1536, got 1024". it's ~0.4% of requests but spikes to 2% during peak. downstream pipeline fails because embedding dims mismatch. sample request_id: req_20260312_09_1245_827. calling model id `open-embed-large-v2`.
Omar (customer): basic info: single account, throughput ~120 req/s, we set max_batch_size=64 and dynamic_batching=true in client config. no recent deploys on our side. this started ~45m ago.
Mia (support): sorry you're hitting this, Omar — can you paste a minimal repro (curl or python) and one full server error log (with request_id)? also which SDK version?
Omar (customer): here's a minimal python snippet we use (aiohttp-based):
```python
async def get_embed(payloads):
    async with session.post(url, json={"model":"open-embed-large-v2","input":payloads}) as r:
        print(await r.json())
```
error payload (sanitized):
```
{"error":"EmbeddingDimensionMismatch","expected":1536,"received":1024,"request_id":"req_20260312_09_1245_827"}
```
Mia (support): thanks. SDK v1.4.1? and are you batching multiple different model names in a single request accidentally? sometimes clients concatenate arrays and send mixed inputs.
Omar (customer): no, our code always sets model param. we log model param per request. those failing requests show model: open-embed-large-v2.
Lena (ml-eng): pinging eng-runtime — this looks like two possibilities: 1) routing to a different model variant (e.g., legacy quantized variant with 1024 output) due to dynamic fallback, or 2) a batching fanout bug that mixes responses from two backends when there are heterogeneous variants behind the same model alias. do you have the full raw response headers for req_20260312_09_1245_827? need backend-instance id and model-variant header.
Omar (customer): grabbed headers: `x-ri-backend: gpu-cluster-11`, `x-ri-variant: open-embed-large-v2-quant128` and `x-ri-trace: trace_0a9f`. but our model catalog shows alias `open-embed-large-v2` should route to `open-embed-large-v2-fp16` normally.
Raj (sre): that header is interesting — variant `quant128` would explain 1024 dims if it was quantized trimmed. I'm going to pull logs from gpu-cluster-11 for the 09:12-09:16 window and look for batching coalescing entries. running: `redwoodctl logs --cluster gpu-cluster-11 --since 09:10 --until 09:18 | grep req_20260312_09_1245_827 -A5 -B5`
DeployBot: Deployment rollback: open-embed-large-v2-quant128 -> rolled back from prod at 09:05 UTC due to perf regressions (triggered by canary alerts). Rollback completed 09:07 UTC. Canary window overlap may have left transient routing entries.
Raj (sre): confirmed multiple backend entries referencing the variant around 09:12. there's an orphaned route on the router which still forwarded a small percentage to the quant128 variant while some requests were landing on fp16 variant. looks like dynamic batching coalesced a batch that included requests serviced by different variants because the router returned mixed backends for a single batch key.
Lena (ml-eng): Aha. the runtime's batch coalescer groups requests by model alias + input shape. it expects the router to give consistent variant for the entire batch. if router returns mixed variant instance ids for requests that end up in the same micro-batch, the response sizes can differ and client sees dimension mismatch. this matches the symptoms (very low % but spikes during routing churn / rollback windows).
Mia (support): immediate mitigation for customer: set max_batch_size=32 or temporarily disable dynamic_batching in client to avoid large coalesced batches until we fix routing consistency. also we can pin requests to a specific model variant by using the full variant name in `model` param (e.g., `open-embed-large-v2-fp16`).
Omar (customer): setting max_batch_size=32 decreased failures to zero in our staging test. we can roll that to prod for now. can you prioritize a fix? this is causing billing & SLA noise.
Ana (support-lead): flagged as P1 for customer impact. opening ticket RI-29762. assign eng-runtime, SRE and ML-eng. notify billing and accounts since customer reported potential billing breaks.
BillingBot: Billing alert created for account acct_8312 to pause automated retries for failed embedding pipeline until incident cleared.
Raj (sre): root cause hypothesis: rollback left stale router entries; router's variant selection algorithm is eventually consistent and can return mixed variant allocations under churn. batch coalescer had no protection against variant mismatch inside a micro-batch.
Lena (ml-eng): proposed fixes:
- Router: enforce single-variant sticky selection for the duration of a micro-batch window (short TTL pinning).
- Runtime: add variant-consistency check in batch coalescer; if responses sizes differ, mark batch as inconsistent and retry requests individually or route to fallback variant.
- Backfill: add an evaluation that simulates rollback churn to catch this in CI.
Raj (sre): I can push a small quick patch to the runtime to detect inconsistent response shapes and fail-open to individual single-request execution (mitigates tail errors). will run canary tonight. patch: `runtime: add per-batch variant consistency check (fast-fail -> split)`.
Ana (support-lead): notify customer timeline: we'll deploy runtime quick patch as canary in 2h, router sticky selection fix in next deploy (~48h). for now, please use the client mitigation (max_batch_size=32 or pin variant). we'll keep you posted.
Omar (customer): appreciated. please include a short repro test we can run to verify after your fix.
Lena (ml-eng): repro for us and the customer:
1) configure router rollback: create variant A (fp16) and variant B (quant128).
2) trigger canary and immediate rollback so router returns mixed allocations for model alias.
3) send concurrent embedding requests (200rps) with max_batch_size=64 and dynamic_batching=true.
Expect: ~1-3% EmbeddingDimensionMismatch during churn. after runtime patch, expect 0.
Mia (support): added notes to the ticket and attached logs + headers. I'll follow up with Omar when patch is canaried.
DeployBot: Canary started: runtime patch ri-runtime-v0.3.14-canary -> 11% traffic at 11:45 UTC.
Omar (customer): canary results? any ETA for full rollback or prod fix?
Raj (sre): looking at canary metrics — variant-consistency check dropped the errors to 0 in canary nodes for the same repro load. rolling to 30% in 30m if no regressions. will update ticket RI-29762.
Ana (support-lead): thanks team. next actions: (1) runtime patch roll out and monitor, (2) router sticky variant fix in 48h, (3) provide customer safe config and repro steps. closing loop once router fix deployed.
Omar (customer): thanks — we'll leave max_batch_size reduced and pin variant until notified. please cc on ticket updates.
